messages:
tom_sales: FYI incoming request from Skylark Finance. They want Dedicated capacity for a latency-sensitive payments workflow. Asking: baseline throughput, burst to handle payroll spikes, and timeline for proof-of-concept.

aisha_pm: got it. Do we have model details and SLO targets from them? P95 latency, expected concurrency, retention/region reqs?

tom_sales: copied from the customer: model family = Llama-2-70B (quantized), expected steady use = ~250 concurrent reqs of ~512 tokens, peak burst up to 900 concurrent for ~15-30min windows (monthly payroll run). P95 latency goal <= 500ms for 512-token response. Region: us-east, private tenancy preferred.

jonas_eng: quick sizing note: rough tokens/sec for quantized 70B on H100-ish inference stack is ~300-400 tok/s/GPU depending on batching. For 250 concurrent * 512 tokens ~128k tokens in flight — we should translate to sustained tok/s requirement.

marta_solutions: customer also wants canary rollout and deterministic fallbacks if capacity gets tight. They care about predictable billing (reserved + burst) not pure autoscale costs.

priya_sre: important: multi-tenant isolation + KMS integration. Also need audit logs for each request and retention. We'll need Private or Dedicated with VPC.

jonas_eng: proposing a starter config for triage (numbers preliminary):
```
pool_config:
  baseline_instances: 6
  max_burst_instances: 12
  instance_type: h100-80g
  autoscale:
    scale_step: 2
    cooldown_sec: 120
    metric: avg_tokens_per_second
```
This assumes ~350 tok/s per GPU -> baseline ~2100 tok/s. If customers' steady concurrency maps to ~1500 tok/s, baseline 6 should cover steady and autoscale covers bursts.

aisha_pm: thanks. Can you add estimated cost delta for reserved (6) + burst to 12 vs fully provisioned 12? We need to present tradeoffs in next call.

jonas_eng: ballpark: reserved 6 * $X/hr + burst usage billed at on-demand rates. I'll pull numbers but expect ~40-55% cost savings vs full 12 reserved.

marta_solutions: scope negotiation: for MVP we should deliver: dedicated pool in us-east, autoscale + burst policy, canary rollout support, and fallback to a smaller 13B family when overload detected. Defer cross-region failover and custom per-customer autoscale policies to later.

priya_sre: launch acceptance criteria proposal: 1) P95 <= 500ms for 512 tokens under baseline load, 2) autoscale triggers within 90s and adds capacity within 180s, 3) rollback path to smaller model with <2% error rate increase, 4) audit/KMS enabled, 5) runbook + playbook for payroll spike.

ops-bot: Created backlog ticket RM-2419 for "Skylark Dedicated Capacity — POC + Sizing" and linked to sale: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RM-2419

aisha_pm: moving to prioritize — this looks like a product+solutions led POC. Tom, can you confirm their timeline? They asked for a POC in ~6 weeks. If true, we need scoping meeting this week to commit engineers.

tom_sales: confirmed 6-week target, customer is willing to sign a short reserved commitment for POC if we can guarantee burst mechanics.

jonas_eng: action items: 1) I'll run a micro-benchmark to tighten tok/s per-device numbers (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Priya to draft security/KMS checklist. 3) Marta to prepare POC runbook and fallback test plan. 4) Aisha to create PRD with acceptance criteria and timeline.

priya_sre: noted, I'll also list required audit retention durations.

aisha_pm: agreed. If benchmarks confirm numbers, we'll scope MVP to the items Marta listed and slot into next cycle. If numbers look worse, we'll propose either larger baseline or different instance type.

marta_solutions: +1. I'll prep a pricing handshake slide with the reserved+burst tradeoffs.

tom_sales: customer asked whether we can do warm standby nodes for faster burst. Jonas: feasibility?

jonas_eng: warm standby is feasible — keep 1-2 pre-warmed instances per pool to reduce cold-start; increases baseline cost a bit, but cuts scale-up latency. Add to runbook.

aisha_pm: perfect. I'll schedule a scoping call for tomorrow 10:30am ET with Skylark + engineering. Please join.

tom_sales: thanks everyone. I'll post the meeting invite and customer materials to the RM-2419 ticket. :thumbsup:

marta_solutions: tagging follow-ups: @jonas_eng @priya_sre @aisha_pm

jonas_eng: noted.
